articles.author: GlobeNewswire / Global Engine
articles.headline: Global Engine Group Holding Limited and Angkasa-X Holdings Corp. Enter Into Memorandum of Understanding to Explore Integration of Satellite Networks, Data Infrastructure, and Blockchain Technology to Support Artificial Intelligence Applications
articles.summary: Global Engine y Angkasa-X anuncian un memorando no vinculante para explorar una plataforma que integre redes satelitales, infraestructura de datos y blockchain para aplicaciones de IA. No se acredita contrato comercial definitivo ni ingresos asociados.

articles.author: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd
articles.headline: Global Engine Group Holding Limited and Angkasa-X Holdings Corp. Enter into Strategic Collaboration to Advance Space-to-AI Edge Infrastructure Platform, Accelerating GLE's Expansion into Next-Generation AI-Powered Digital Infrastructure
articles.summary: Global Engine announced an agreement with Angkasa-X for feasibility and proof-of-concept work on a Sarawak satellite-data and edge-computing platform. The project remains development work rather than a completed operational constellation.
